_comment: Curated fallback for MoleculeNet leaderboard metrics, used when scraping moleculenet.org fails. Values are representative best-model test scores from Wu et al. 2018 (MoleculeNet, Chem. Sci.) and the DeepChem benchmark; treat as references, not ground truth. 'split' records the split MoleculeNet recommends/reports for that set (scaffold for BBBP/BACE/HIV, random for the rest). Keyed by dataset family.

tox21.source: Wu et al. 2018 (MoleculeNet), best model (12-task avg)

clintox.source: Wu et al. 2018 (MoleculeNet), best model (2-task avg)

sider.source: Wu et al. 2018 (MoleculeNet), best model (27-task avg)

muv.source: Wu et al. 2018 (MoleculeNet), best model (17-task avg)

toxcast.source: Wu et al. 2018 (MoleculeNet), best model (617-task avg)
